name: heronhex-highered
description: Read-only access to free public U.S. higher-education data: institution profiles, enrollment, retention and finance, Title IV risk flags, Single Audit findings, accreditation, research and state funding, and wages and program-to-job alignment. Five local servers plus skills; no data is hosted or collected.

scorecard_api_key.title: College Scorecard API key
scorecard_api_key.description: Free key from https://api.data.gov/signup. Optional; without it a shared demo key is used and is quickly rate limited.

fac_api_key.title: Federal Audit Clearinghouse API key
fac_api_key.description: Free api.data.gov key (the same signup works). Optional; without it the shared demo key allows only about 10 requests.

contact_email.title: Contact email for BLS
contact_email.description: BLS asks for a contact address with bulk file requests. Sent only to www.bls.gov, never logged. Needed for the occupation projections file.
